doc: Read, find, act on, wait for, capture and inspect a running application's semantic tree.

tools.name: ui.describe
tools.description: What this endpoint is: the protocol, the application, its operations, the session's policy and the application's verbs

tools.name: ui.snapshot
tools.description: The semantic tree, or a part of it

root.description: a node (its id): the subtree's root (the window when absent)

depth.description: levels below the root (all when absent)

interactive.description: only nodes a person or an agent can act on

offset.description: the first node of a page

tools.name: ui.changes
tools.description: What changed in the tree since the last snapshot or changes

tools.name: ui.find
tools.description: Nodes matching a query (role, name, id, state; wildcards)

tools.name: ui.act
tools.description: Perform a node's action, under that action's effect (an irreversible one asks the person)
tools.undo: the action's own: ui.undo for a reversible one; an irreversible one cannot be taken back

action.description: one of the node's actions (activate, toggle, set_value, …)

answer.description: the person's answer, when the action asks

tools.name: ui.invoke
tools.description: Call one of the application's verbs, under its declared effect
tools.undo: the verb's own (an undoable verb: ui.undo)

answer.description: the person's answer, when the verb asks

tools.name: ui.undo
tools.description: Take back the last change in a history scope

scope.description: a node (its id): a node's undo scope (the window's when absent)

tools.name: ui.redo
tools.description: Do again what ui.undo took back

tools.name: ui.transaction
tools.description: Steps performed as one: all done, or all taken back
tools.undo: ui.undo takes the whole transaction back

steps.description: a list of {node, action, args, answer}

tools.name: ui.preview
tools.description: What steps would make, shown before it is allowed: pictures before and after, the semantic changes; nothing stays

pictures.description: with the pictures (default: when the host renders)

tools.name: ui.history
tools.description: A history scope's changes, what can be undone and redone

tools.name: ui.wait
tools.description: Answer when a condition holds: a node present or absent, the tree settled

absent.description: a query that must not match

tools.name: ui.capture
tools.description: The picture as drawn: the window, a node, or a region of it, as PNG pixels or as SVG with every node's drawing marked

region.description: [x, y, width, height] from the node's corner, in logical pixels

format.description: png (pixels, the default) or svg (vectors at any size; each node's drawing a group marked data-node with its path; what SVG cannot say kept as pixels, listed in `islands`)

tools.name: ui.input
tools.description: A person's input as their devices give it (pointer, keys, text), delivered a frame at a time; answers what each press hit
tools.undo: what the input performed is the actions' own (ui.undo for reversible ones)

events.description: a list of {type: move, click, drag, wheel, key, keys, text, wait, …}

tools.name: ui.drew
tools.description: What drew a pixel: the node its colour came from, the nodes it sits in, and where in the program each was built

tools.name: ui.inspect
tools.description: A node's layout, style, state, bindings and motion, for development

tools.name: ui.stats
tools.description: Frame times (mean, percentiles, phases) and the last frame's counts

history.description: the last frames, oldest first (up to 240)

tools.name: ui.profile
tools.description: Start or stop recording a trace; stopping answers its summary (and Chrome's format)

tools.name: ui.logs
tools.description: Recent log records, by level and category

level.description: trace, debug, info, warning or error

tools.name: ui.debug
tools.description: Debug overlays (bounds, repaints, inspector, HUD), the slow-frame threshold and the log filter
tools.undo: ui.debug with the values it answered before

tools.name: ui.pipeline
tools.description: The frame's pipeline: show it (a read), or replace, insert or remove one stage between frames
tools.undo: the opposite change: the stage as show read it

action.description: show (the default), replace, insert or remove

tools.name: ui.clock
tools.description: The application's time: show it (a read), or pause, resume, rate, step, seek and release
tools.undo: release gives the time back to the host

action.description: show (the default), pause, resume, rate, step, seek or release

seconds.description: seconds: step by, or seek to
